commands.name: discover
commands.summary: Read public service compatibility and available commands.

commands.name: onboard
commands.summary: Prepare a local-only human authorization request; no enrollment or outreach.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Inspect local state or verify current host enrollment and standing permissions.
commands.network: Signed GET status when locally enrolled; --local-only skips network

commands.name: enroll
commands.summary: Redeem a human-issued setup code using the existing host key; recover interrupted registration.

commands.name: whoami
commands.summary: Inspect the currently authorized host identity.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: Inspect independent standing Join, Post and Create permissions.

commands.name: groups
commands.summary: Browse, show, create, join, leave and reconcile Public Groups using independent standing host permissions. Resume interrupted local installation by operation ID.
commands.network: signed groups/themes API; existing Antenna send unchanged

commands.name: reports
commands.summary: Submit and inspect private member requests for administrator group removal. No automatic deletion.
